zh.headline: Anthropic 与白宫爆发冲突，Claude Fable 5 被要求下线
zh.observation: 今日最重磅的信号无疑是 Anthropic 与白宫围绕 Claude Fable 5 的冲突，这不仅是 AI 安全与出口管制的博弈，更可能成为“主权 AI”运动的催化剂——当美国可以随时切断最先进模型的海外访问，非美国地区的企业和政府将加速自建 AI 能力。与此同时，SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor 标志着科技巨头对 AI 编程工具的争夺进入白热化，编程助手赛道正在从“工具”升级为“平台级基础设施”。在开源社区，Agent 生态正在快速成熟：Omnigent 解决了多 Agent 管理碎片化问题，Headroom 和 Codegraph 则从成本和效率角度优化 Agent 的实际部署体验，这些工具的组合使用可能成为下一阶段 Agent 开发的标准栈。

items.title: Anthropic 与白宫爆发冲突，Claude Fable 5 被要求下线
items.desc: 美国出口管制指令要求 Anthropic 暂停对海外用户（包括其自身外籍员工）开放其最新模型 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5，Anthropic 高管赴华盛顿谈判后仍存分歧。
items.value: 揭示前沿模型受地缘政治影响的风险，加速主权 AI 趋势。

items.title: Anthropic 与政府冲突反促商业增长，销售数据表明
items.desc: 根据 Ramp 的数据，Anthropic 与特朗普政府的公开争执反而提升了其在企业用户中的受欢迎程度。
items.value: 争议营销效应在 AI 企业级市场同样奏效，品牌立场影响采购决策。

items.title: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元股票收购 Cursor
items.desc: SpaceX 在 IPO 数日后宣布以 600 亿美元股票收购 AI 编程工具公司 Cursor，旨在强化其 AI 部门并争夺企业客户。
items.value: 巨型科技公司吞并 AI 明星项目，编程助手赛道迎来最强跨界竞争者。

items.title: Google 发布 Android 17，深度集成 Gemini AI 功能
items.desc: Android 17 和 Wear OS 7 正式发布，引入全新多任务工具、家长控制和安全功能，并伴随 Pixel Drop 将 Google 最新 AI 模型部署至设备端。
items.value: AI 成为移动操作系统核心能力，影响数十亿用户交互方式。

items.title: 阿里发布首个具身大模型 Qwen-Robot 系列
items.desc: 阿里巴巴推出 Qwen-Robot 系列模型，实现机器人“边走、边看、边思考”的全身协同能力。
items.value: 国内首个端到端具身大模型，推动机器人从单任务向通用协同进化。

items.title: 一个模型控制手脚腰身，机器人学会全身协同干精细活
items.desc: 研究团队提出新方法，让机器人首次实现全身协同完成精细操作任务。
items.value: 突破“手的问题不在手”的认知，全身协调是精细操作关键。

items.title: Facebook 推出 AI Mode 搜索，基于公开帖子生成结果
items.desc: Meta 在 Facebook 中推出 AI Mode 搜索功能，搜索结果基于用户公开帖子生成，同时推出多项新 AI 功能。
items.value: 社交平台 AI 搜索化，用户数据成为模型训练和推理的实时语料。

items.title: Meta CTO 承认公司 AI 重组“糟糕透顶”
items.desc: Andrew Bosworth 在内部备忘录中承认 AI 重组执行不力，承诺将改善稳定性、沟通和员工福利。
items.value: 大公司 AI 组织变革的阵痛，人才管理和文化冲突是落地关键挑战。

items.title: Meta 与五角大楼供应商合作，为智能眼镜原型开发面部识别
items.desc: Meta 与 Rank One Computing（其董事会包括前 CIA 副局长）合作，为其智能眼镜应用开发面部识别功能。
items.value: 智能眼镜+面部识别的隐私与伦理争议再起，监管压力将持续增大。

items.title: Qualcomm 发布 Snapdragon Reality Elite 芯片，为下一代智能眼镜铺路
items.desc: 高通发布新款 XR 芯片，旨在为更强大的智能眼镜设备提供算力支持。
items.value: 硬件底座的升级将加速 AI 可穿戴设备的普及和体验提升。

items.title: DeepSeek 融资细节曝光：梁文锋如何保住控制权
items.desc: 报道揭示了 DeepSeek 融资过程中的关键条款设计，梁文锋通过精妙架构保持对公司的控制权。
items.value: 为 AI 创业者提供融资谈判范本，控制权设计是创始人核心课题。

items.title: Plaud 软件业务 ARR 突破 1 亿美元，AI 记事本出货超 200 万台
items.desc: Plaud 宣布其 AI 会议记录硬件配套软件业务年经常性收入突破 1 亿美元。
items.value: AI 硬件+订阅模式验证成功，垂直场景 AI 工具商业化路径清晰。

items.title: Probably 获 900 万美元融资，打造更可靠的 AI 系统
items.desc: Probably 旨在防止 AI 产生幻觉和事实错误，追求达到确定性系统级别的准确率。
items.value: AI 可靠性是商业化最大障碍，该方向获资本持续押注。

items.title: 微信支付“AI 专属卡”最快本周上线
items.desc: 微信支付即将推出 AI 专属卡功能，或将改变支付行业格局。
items.value: AI 与支付场景深度融合，可能重塑用户支付习惯和行业竞争格局。

items.title: ExpRL：利用探索性强化学习提升 LLM 推理能力
items.desc: 提出一种通过 RL 探索自动发现有用推理原语（如分解、验证、自我修正）的方法，替代人工标注推理轨迹。
items.value: 减少人工标注依赖，让模型自主发现更优推理策略。

items.title: Human Universal Grasping (HUG)：从人类抓取数据学习通用机器人抓取
items.desc: 通过智能眼镜收集 100 万帧第一人称抓取数据，训练流匹配模型生成多样化抓取姿态。
items.value: 利用人类日常数据解决机器人灵巧抓取泛化难题，数据规模是关键突破。

items.title: LaWAM：潜在世界动作模型，实现高效动力学感知机器人策略
items.desc: 在潜空间中预测动作后果，避免昂贵的像素级视频生成，实现高效机器人控制。
items.value: 潜空间世界模型显著降低具身智能的计算开销，提升部署效率。

items.title: Ling 和 Ring 2.6 技术报告：万亿参数规模的高效即时智能体
items.desc: Ling-2.6 优化即时响应生成，Ring-2.6 专注深度推理，实现高效训练、服务和部署。
items.value: 万亿参数模型兼顾低延迟与强推理，为 Agent 场景提供实用架构。

items.title: Prompt-Level Distillation：提示级蒸馏，替代模型微调的高效推理方案
items.desc: 从教师模型中提取推理模式并组织为结构化提示列表，无需微调即可提升小模型推理能力。
items.value: 零训练成本的模型能力迁移方案，适合资源受限场景。

items.title: DreamX-World 1.0：通用交互式世界模型
items.desc: 支持可控长时视频生成，包括相机导航、场景重访和可提示事件，覆盖真实、游戏和风格化领域。
items.value: 通用世界模型为游戏、影视和仿真提供统一生成框架。

items.title: MVEB：大规模视频嵌入基准测试
items.desc: 包含 23 个任务的视频嵌入基准，评估 33 个模型，发现 MLLM 嵌入在多数任务上领先。
items.value: 为视频理解模型选型提供系统化评估标准，填补视频嵌入基准空白。

items.title: MMDiff：将扩散 Transformer 扩展为多模态生成系统
items.desc: 利用冻结扩散 Transformer 的中间表示，通过轻量解码头同时生成图像和多种密集感知模态。
items.value: 一个模型完成多模态生成，避免训练多个专用模型的开销。

items.title: Agent-Reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach)
items.desc: 为 AI Agent 提供“眼睛”，支持通过一个 CLI 免费搜索和读取 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等全网内容。
items.value: 零 API 费用的多平台信息获取工具，大幅降低 Agent 开发成本。

items.title: Omnigent](https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent)
items.desc: 统一的 AI Agent 元框架，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 Agent 的切换、组合、策略沙箱和实时协作。
items.value: 解决多 Agent 工具碎片化问题，提供统一管理和协作层。

items.title: Kronos](https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos)
items.desc: 金融市场的语言基础模型，专用于金融数据理解和分析。
items.value: 垂直领域基础模型，有望提升金融量化分析和风险预测能力。

items.title: Headroom](https://github.com/chopratejas/headroom)
items.desc: 在工具输出到达 LLM 前进行压缩，减少 60-95% token 消耗，同时保证答案质量。提供库、代理和 MCP 服务器三种使用方式。
items.value: 显著降低 API 成本，适合高频调用场景，提升推理效率。

items.title: Codegraph](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph)
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等 Agent 提供预索引的代码知识图谱，减少 token 消耗和工具调用。
items.value: 100% 本地化的代码理解增强方案，提升编码 Agent 的上下文感知能力。

items.title: Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
items.desc: 让 AI Agent 像最懒的高级开发人员一样思考，遵循“最好的代码是没写的代码”原则。
items.value: 改变 AI 编码的“过度生成”问题，强调简洁和最小化代码。

items.title: Hello-Agents](https://github.com/datawhalechina/hello-agents)
items.desc: DataWhale 出品的《从零开始构建智能体》教程，系统讲解 Agent 原理与实践。
items.value: 优质中文学习资源，降低 Agent 开发入门门槛，适合初学者。

items.title: Sub2API](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api)
items.desc: 一站式开源中转服务，统一接入 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 等订阅，支持拼车共享和原生工具使用。
items.value: 解决多 API 订阅管理痛点，降低个人和团队使用成本。

en.headline: Anthropic Clashes with White House, Claude Fable 5 Taken Offline
en.observation: The most significant signal today is undoubtedly the Anthropic-White House clash over Claude Fable 5. This is not just a game of AI safety and export controls, but could become a catalyst for the "sovereign AI" movement—when the US can cut off access to its most advanced models at any time, non-US enterprises and governments will accelerate building their own AI capabilities. Meanwhile, SpaceX's $60 billion acquisition of Cursor marks the escalation of big tech's battle for AI coding tools, with the coding assistant赛道 transitioning from "tool" to "platform-level infrastructure." In the open-source community, the agent ecosystem is rapidly maturing: Omnigent solves multi-agent management fragmentation, while Headroom and Codegraph optimize real-world agent deployment from cost and efficiency perspectives. The combined use of these tools may become the standard stack for the next phase of agent development.

items.title: Anthropic Clashes with White House, Claude Fable 5 Taken Offline
items.desc: US export control directive forces Anthropic to suspend access to its latest models Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign users (including its own non-US employees); high-level talks in Washington remain unresolved.
items.value: Reveals geopolitical risks for frontier models, accelerating sovereign AI trends.

items.title: Anthropic's Clash with Government May Actually Boost Sales, Data Suggests
items.desc: According to Ramp data, Anthropic's public feud with the Trump administration is increasing its popularity among business users.
items.value: Controversy marketing works in enterprise AI; brand stance influences procurement decisions.

items.title: SpaceX Acquires Cursor for $60 Billion in Stock
items.desc: Days after its IPO, SpaceX announces a $60 billion stock deal to acquire AI coding tool company Cursor, aiming to strengthen its AI division and compete for enterprise customers.
items.value: Mega-tech swallows star AI project; coding assistant gets its strongest cross-industry competitor.

items.title: Google Launches Android 17 with Deep Gemini AI Integration
items.desc: Android 17 and Wear OS 7 officially launch with new multitasking tools, parental controls, security features, and a Pixel Drop deploying Google's latest AI models on-device.
items.value: AI becomes core mobile OS capability, impacting interaction patterns for billions of users.

items.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen-Robot Series, Its First Embodied Foundation Model
items.desc: Alibaba launches the Qwen-Robot model series, enabling robots to walk, see, and think with full-body coordination.
items.value: China's first end-to-end embodied foundation model, pushing robots from single-task to general coordination.

items.title: One Model Controls Hands, Feet, and Torso: Robots Learn Full-Body Coordination for Fine Tasks
items.desc: Research team proposes a new method enabling robots to perform fine manipulation tasks with full-body coordination for the first time.
items.value: Breaks the "hand problem isn't about hands" paradigm; whole-body coordination is key for dexterous tasks.

items.title: Facebook Launches AI Mode Search, Generates Results from Public Posts
items.desc: Meta introduces AI Mode search on Facebook, generating results from users' public posts, alongside several new AI features.
items.value: Social platform AI searchification; user data becomes real-time training and inference corpus.

items.title: Meta CTO Admits Company's AI Reorganization Was 'Atrocious'
items.desc: Andrew Bosworth acknowledges poor execution of AI reorganization in an internal memo, promising better stability, communication, and employee benefits.
items.value: Growing pains of big tech AI org changes; talent management and culture clash are key deployment challenges.

items.title: Meta Partnered with Pentagon Supplier to Prototype Face Recognition for Smart Glasses
items.desc: Meta worked with Rank One Computing (whose board includes a former CIA deputy director) to develop face recognition for its smart glasses app.
items.value: Privacy and ethics controversy around smart glasses + face recognition reignites; regulatory pressure will increase.

items.title: Qualcomm Unveils Snapdragon Reality Elite Chip, Paving Way for Next-Gen Smart Glasses
items.desc: Qualcomm releases a new XR chip designed to power more capable smart glasses devices.
items.value: Hardware base upgrades will accelerate AI wearable adoption and experience improvement.

items.title: DeepSeek Funding Details Revealed: How Liang Wenfeng Retained Control
items.desc: The report uncovers key term sheet designs in DeepSeek's funding process, showing how Liang Wenfeng maintained control through clever structuring.
items.value: Provides a funding negotiation template for AI founders; control design is a core founder challenge.

items.title: Plaud Software Business Hits $100M ARR, Ships Over 2M AI Notetakers
items.desc: Plaud announces its AI meeting note-taking hardware's accompanying software business surpassed $100 million in annual recurring revenue.
items.value: AI hardware + subscription model validated; commercialization path for vertical AI tools is clear.

items.title: Probably Raises $9M to Build More Reliable AI
items.desc: Probably aims to prevent AI hallucinations and factual errors, targeting accuracy on par with deterministic systems.
items.value: AI reliability is the biggest barrier to commercialization; capital continues to bet on this direction.

items.title: WeChat Pay 'AI Exclusive Card' Expected to Launch This Week
items.desc: WeChat Pay is about to launch an AI exclusive card feature, potentially reshaping the payments industry landscape.
items.value: Deep integration of AI and payments may reshape user habits and industry competition.

items.title: ExpRL: Improving LLM Reasoning with Exploratory Reinforcement Learning
items.desc: Proposes a method using RL exploration to automatically discover useful reasoning primitives (decomposition, verification, self-correction), replacing manual annotation of reasoning traces.
items.value: Reduces human annotation dependency; lets models autonomously discover better reasoning strategies.

items.title: Human Universal Grasping (HUG): Learning General Robot Grasping from Human Data
items.desc: Collects 1M frames of egocentric grasping data via smart glasses, training a flow-matching model to generate diverse grasping poses.
items.value: Solves dexterous grasping generalization using daily human data; data scale is the key breakthrough.

items.title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
items.desc: Predicts action consequences in latent space, avoiding expensive pixel-level video generation for efficient robot control.
items.value: Latent space world models significantly reduce computational cost for embodied AI, improving deployment efficiency.

items.title: Ling and Ring 2.6 Technical Report: Efficient Instant Agentic Intelligence at Trillion-Parameter Scale
items.desc: Ling-2.6 optimizes instant response generation, Ring-2.6 focuses on deep reasoning, achieving efficient training, serving, and deployment.
items.value: Trillion-parameter models balancing low latency and strong reasoning; provides practical architecture for agent scenarios.

items.title: Prompt-Level Distillation: An Efficient Alternative to Model Fine-Tuning for Reasoning
items.desc: Extracts reasoning patterns from a Teacher model into a structured prompt list, improving small model reasoning without fine-tuning.
items.value: Zero-training-cost model capability transfer; suitable for resource-constrained scenarios.

items.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
items.desc: Supports controllable long-horizon video generation including camera navigation, scene revisits, and promptable events across realistic, game, and stylized domains.
items.value: General world model provides a unified generation framework for games, film, and simulation.

items.title: MVEB: Massive Video Embedding Benchmark
items.desc: A 23-task video embedding benchmark evaluating 33 models, finding MLLM embeddings lead on most tasks.
items.value: Provides systematic evaluation standards for video understanding model selection; fills video embedding benchmark gap.

items.title: MMDiff: Extending Diffusion Transformers for Multi-Modal Generation
items.desc: Leverages intermediate representations of frozen diffusion transformers with lightweight decoder heads to simultaneously generate images and multiple dense perceptual modalities.
items.value: One model for multi-modal generation, avoiding training multiple specialized models.

items.title: Agent-Reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach)
items.desc: Gives AI agents "eyes" to search and read Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more via a single CLI, with zero API fees.
items.value: Zero-cost multi-platform information access tool, drastically reducing agent development costs.

items.title: Omnigent](https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent)
items.desc: A unified meta-framework for AI agents, supporting switching, combining, policy sandboxing, and real-time collaboration across Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and custom agents.
items.value: Solves multi-agent tool fragmentation; provides unified management and collaboration layer.

items.title: Kronos](https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos)
items.desc: A foundation model for the language of financial markets, specialized for financial data understanding and analysis.
items.value: Vertical domain foundation model promising to improve quantitative analysis and risk prediction.

items.title: Headroom](https://github.com/chopratejas/headroom)
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs before they reach the LLM, reducing token consumption by 60-95% while maintaining answer quality. Available as a library, proxy, and MCP server.
items.value: Significantly reduces API costs; suitable for high-frequency calling scenarios; improves inference efficiency.

items.title: Codegraph](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph)
items.desc: Provides pre-indexed code knowledge graphs for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and other agents, reducing token consumption and tool calls.
items.value: 100% local code understanding enhancement; improves coding agents' context awareness.

items.title: Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
items.desc: Makes AI agents think like the laziest senior developer, following the principle that "the best code is the code you never wrote."
items.value: Addresses AI's "over-generation" problem; emphasizes concise and minimal code.

items.title: Hello-Agents](https://github.com/datawhalechina/hello-agents)
items.desc: A tutorial by DataWhale titled "Building Agents from Scratch," systematically covering agent principles and practice.
items.value: High-quality Chinese learning resource; lowers the barrier to agent development for beginners.

items.title: Sub2API](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api)
items.desc: An all-in-one open-source relay service, unifying subscriptions for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and others, supporting ride-sharing and native tool use.
items.value: Solves multi-API subscription management pain points; reduces costs for individuals and teams.
